_purpose: Hosts a code URL literal may target without being declared in a canonical registry (feed_registry / crawl_seeds / source_manifest / anticipated_updates). Every entry carries a reason. Checked by tools/count_truth.py check_url_provenance (via health_audit).

allowed_hosts.purl.org: XML namespace identifier inside feed parsers - never fetched
allowed_hosts.www.w3.org: XML namespace identifier inside feed parsers - never fetched
allowed_hosts.api.github.com: GitHub API polling used by release monitors; individual repos are declared per-feed
allowed_hosts.raw.githubusercontent.com: raw artifact fetch for feeds pinned in feed_registry/source_manifest
allowed_hosts.github.com: release-tag URL construction for feeds pinned in feed_registry
allowed_hosts.archive.org: Wayback availability API - labeled-fallback fetching only (fetchkit)
allowed_hosts.cyber.mil: CCI-list origin cited in DISA XML metadata; the artifact itself is fetched from dl.dod.cyber.mil (registry-declared)
